subject: Mathematics
summary: Pair 2 hits Level 4 across the board. E1.2 compose/decompose is taught and practised faithfully; expanded_walkthrough names the partial-decompose trap with Battista (2007) spatial structuring and Sarama & Clements (2009) composition trajectories, and recovery_moves branches across three diagnostics (A partial-decompose, B cannot recompose, C cannot articulate). Materials are paper cards and anchor charts with puppets explicitly OPTIONAL and a NO-MATERIALS VERSION using body and classroom objects (book stack as rectangular prism). Coco's compose refrain 'BUILD it BIG, BREAK it small — both ways are MATH!' anchors the hook and the exit routine three times. Action step 6 is a STRATEGY COMPARE — 'Two ways to build it' — letting pairs compose the same target two different ways (4-cube tower vs L-shape) with the Battista (2007) citation in-line. Worksheet Parts 1-3 map cleanly to the success criteria and vary the format (independent draw_or_write vs partnered build) with Part 3 generalising 2D-inside-3D to a second solid (cylinder cross-section). Time 12/25/13 = 50 min sits in the G3 band.
